proposedchanges.value: Trump Praises Pardons in War-Crime Cases and Credits Hegseth With Lobbying

In a March 3, 2025 interview, Trump praised clemency decisions involving three service members whose cases included killings in Afghanistan. The cases differed: Clint Lorance was convicted of murder, Mathew Golsteyn faced a murder charge, and Eddie Gallagher was acquitted of murder but convicted of posing with an Islamic State prisoner’s corpse. Trump credited Pete Hegseth with lobbying for the pardons and said the men had been punished for being “too aggressive militarily.”
